items.title: Bill Crow interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995

ctx.x: featured them on a number called “Two Franks.” And Benny Powell was in the trombone section, Wendell Cully I think. Thad Jones hadn’t come on the band yet I think. I can’t remember now whether Joe Wilder was there or not. But I know there was a lot of changing around that went on from time to time in the band.

Marshall was the section leader, right. And Charlie Fowlkes was the baritone player. And Freddie Green of course was in. And I can’t remember now whether it was that time or the next time that he came in that Joe Williams was with him. It seems to me that he didn’t have a singer that first time when we were opposite them. Because it seems to me I seem to remember my wife being there — she wasn’t my wife at that time — but a girl I’d started to go with was the camera girl at Birdland. And at that time I was at the…
